Phone field → objection killed in the placeholder

“Phone (for text reminders — we will NEVER call you)”. He names the exact fear the field creates and kills it inside the placeholder text. Every other funnel in this swipe file takes the number under autodial consent and says nothing. Cheapest conversion fix in the whole set, and directly testable on our own opt-in.

VERIFIED · form inspected live 31 Jul
Registers → routed into a Facebook group

The challenge is delivered in a group rather than a webinar room. Attendance becomes social, peer proof accumulates in public where prospects can see it, and the asset persists after the week ends. Our masterclass evaporates the moment the Zoom closes.
